newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi offers bonds worth 1.675 billion riyals.
newsitem.headline: Saudi offers bonds worth 1.675 billion riyals.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has issued government bonds for three, four and five years worth 1.675 billion riyals, bankers said on Sunday.
They said the bonds were offered by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency to local banks on Saturday for settlement on Wednesday.
The bankers said the coupon for three-year bonds, maturing on January 15, 2000, and worth 450 million riyals were put at 6.53 percent.

The coupon for the four-year bonds worth one billion riyals and maturing on January 15, 2001 were put at 6.68 percent while the coupon of five-year bonds worth 225 million riyals were at 6.88 percent. ($1=3.75 riyals) -- Manama newsroom +973-536187
